name: interpro-mcp-server
description: Search InterPro entries, map protein domains and functional sites, and find proteins by domain via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: Search InterPro entries, map protein domains and functional sites, and find proteins by domain via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.
interface.longDescription: Reads InterPro and the member databases it integrates (Pfam, PROSITE, SMART, CDD, PANTHER, and others) through the keyless EMBL-EBI API. Search InterPro entries by GO annotation or entries and member signatures by text or type, read their full metadata, map a UniProt protein's domains, repeats, and functional sites to residue coordinates, walk Pfam, CDD, and PIRSF clans, and find the proteins that carry a signature, by default reviewed human proteins. Results are read-only and paged with cursors, and no credentials are needed.
